title: Initialize monorepo and development commands
body:
## Objective
Make the React/FastAPI/Firebase scaffold reproducible for all five members.

## Owner role
Lead and integration

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `make install` prepares web and API dependencies.
- [ ] `make web` and `make api` start documented local services.
- [ ] The neutral skeleton works without cloud credentials.
- [ ] `.env.example` contains every required variable and no secrets.

## Depends on
None

## Demo evidence
Attach terminal output and links to both local health screens.

title: Configure CI and protected main workflow
body:
## Objective
Make every merge reviewable and keep `main` demo-ready.

## Owner role
Lead and integration

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Frontend and backend checks run on each PR.
- [ ] The “Freeze OpenAPI request and response examples” issue adds Contract CI after the first contract is frozen.
- [ ] One approval, resolved conversations, passing checks, and linear history are required.
- [ ] Force pushes/deletion are blocked and squash merge is enabled.

## Depends on
#1

## Demo evidence
Link one PR where all required checks pass.

title: Configure shared deployment environments
body:
## Objective
Expose stable shared web and API environments early.

## Owner role
Lead and integration

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Vercel web placeholder is reachable.
- [ ] Railway API `/health` is reachable.
- [ ] Production CORS/environment values are documented.
- [ ] No service-account material appears in source or logs.

## Depends on
#1

## Demo evidence
Add both deployment links and health output.

title: Create Firebase project, emulators, and environment template
body:
## Objective
Provide Auth, Firestore, and Storage for local and shared development.

## Owner role
Backend and Firebase

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Shared Firebase project and web app exist.
- [ ] Auth, Firestore, and Storage are enabled.
- [ ] Local emulators start from `firebase.json`.
- [ ] Web/API connect through documented environment variables.

## Depends on
#1

## Demo evidence
Attach Emulator UI and shared project screenshots without secrets.

title: Implement Firestore model, rules, indexes, and seed baseline
body:
## Objective
Create the minimum organization-isolated data foundation.

## Owner role
Backend and Firebase

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] P0 collection paths and indexes exist.
- [ ] Firestore/Storage rules deny cross-organization access.
- [ ] Client writes to confirmed business records are denied.
- [ ] Synthetic data loads into an empty emulator/project.

## Depends on
#4

## Demo evidence
Attach emulator rule-test output and seeded collection screenshot.

title: Freeze OpenAPI request and response examples
body:
## Objective
Give frontend and backend one typed P0 contract.

## Owner role
Lead and integration + Backend and Firebase

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every P0 endpoint has validated schemas and examples.
- [ ] OpenAPI JSON is generated from FastAPI.
- [ ] TypeScript types are generated from OpenAPI.
- [ ] Contract drift fails CI.

## Depends on
#5

## Demo evidence
Link generated artifacts and passing Contract CI.

title: Build merchant dashboard shell
body:
## Objective
Show a useful merchant situation and next action from seeded data.

## Owner role
Merchant Experience

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] KPIs, inventory health, and one stockout alert render.
- [ ] All currency includes MAD.
- [ ] Layout works at 375 px and desktop widths.
- [ ] Loading, empty, and error states exist.

## Depends on
#6

## Demo evidence
Attach mobile and desktop screenshots.

title: Build evidence upload and draft review
body:
## Objective
Let a merchant turn evidence into a reviewable, never-auto-confirmed draft.

## Owner role
Merchant Experience

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Supported file validation is visible.
- [ ] Extracted lines, confidence, and clarification are reviewable.
- [ ] User can edit, discard, or confirm.
- [ ] Inventory cannot change before confirmation.

## Depends on
#6

## Demo evidence
Record upload through explicit confirmation.

title: Build supplier dashboard shell
body:
## Objective
Show qualified demand and offers without leaking merchant finances.

## Owner role
Supplier Experience

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Catalog, qualified demand, active offers, and revenue render.
- [ ] No merchant identity, exact sales, cash, or private data appears.
- [ ] Layout works at 375 px and desktop widths.
- [ ] Loading, empty, and error states exist.

## Depends on
#6

## Demo evidence
Attach mobile and desktop screenshots.

title: Build collective-order decision interface
body:
## Objective
Make savings, conditions, and human consent clear to both sides.

## Owner role
Supplier Experience

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Merchant sees own quantity, prices, delivery share, savings, conditions, and deadline.
- [ ] Join and approve are separate actions.
- [ ] Supplier sees only consolidated opportunity data.
- [ ] Success and recovery feedback are visible.

## Depends on
#6

## Demo evidence
Record merchant approval and supplier update.

title: Implement ingestion API and review lifecycle
body:
## Objective
Persist evidence and validated extraction drafts safely.

## Owner role
Backend and Firebase

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Valid upload creates document, job, and draft records.
- [ ] File type/size and model output validation are enforced.
- [ ] Draft is organization-scoped and auditable.
- [ ] Confirmation atomically creates records/movements exactly once.

## Depends on
#5

## API
`POST /api/v1/ingestions`, `POST /api/v1/ingestions/{id}/confirm`

## Demo evidence
Attach API test output.

title: Implement transaction, inventory, and dashboard APIs
body:
## Objective
Make confirmed evidence update authoritative business views.

## Owner role
Backend and Firebase

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Confirmed transaction changes stock/dashboard exactly once.
- [ ] Every query uses verified Firebase membership and organization scope.
- [ ] Retry/idempotency tests pass.
- [ ] Cross-organization tests prove denial.

## Depends on
#5

## Demo evidence
Attach tests and before/after responses.

title: Define AI provider interface and deterministic fixtures
body:
## Objective
Unblock every team member and guarantee demo recovery.

## Owner role
Gemma and Procurement

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Fixture and hosted providers implement one typed interface.
- [ ] Fixture yields approved line items and clarification.
- [ ] Output passes the same Pydantic validation as live output.
- [ ] Agent run and tool-call timeline are recorded.

## Depends on
#6

## Demo evidence
Attach provider contract tests.

title: Integrate Gemma multimodal extraction
body:
## Objective
Extract a validated draft from the known receipt and Darija/French audio.

## Owner role
Gemma and Procurement

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Receipt and voice fixtures produce expected draft fields.
- [ ] Ambiguity produces one concise clarification.
- [ ] Prompt forbids authoritative writes and invented totals.
- [ ] Timeout/failure switches safely to fixture recovery.

## Depends on
#13

## Demo evidence
Attach sanitized run output for both inputs.

title: Implement deterministic stockout forecast
body:
## Objective
Turn confirmed inventory history into the demo purchasing need.

## Owner role
Gemma and Procurement + Backend and Firebase

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Oil produces a four-day warning and 20-unit need.
- [ ] Zero/negative demand and insufficient history are tested.
- [ ] Calculation is deterministic and currency-free.
- [ ] Explanation cites real inputs and uncertainty.

## Depends on
#12

## Demo evidence
Attach unit tests and seeded API response.

title: Implement supplier matching and offer comparison
body:
## Objective
Compare three offers with transparent deterministic criteria.

## Owner role
Gemma and Procurement + Backend and Firebase

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Three seeded offers rank by landed cost and constraints.
- [ ] MOQ, delivery, cash, and margin tradeoffs are exposed.
- [ ] Explanation matches actual ranking inputs.
- [ ] Tie and unaffordable-offer behavior is tested.

## Depends on
#12

## Demo evidence
Attach ranking tests and response.

title: Implement collective-order matching
body:
## Objective
Combine compatible demand without exposing private merchant records.

## Owner role
Gemma and Procurement + Backend and Firebase

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 20 + 35 units create one 55-unit proposal.
- [ ] Product saving is 70 MAD; delivery saving 30 MAD; total 100 MAD.
- [ ] Participants approve independently.
- [ ] Supplier sees aggregated demand only.

## Depends on
#15, #16

## Demo evidence
Attach calculation/privacy tests and proposal response.

title: Connect complete vertical demo path
body:
## Objective
Make the full merchant-to-supplier story work in the shared deployment.

## Owner role
Lead and integration + all

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All 16 demo steps complete from a clean seed.
- [ ] Agent/tool timeline is visible.
- [ ] Firebase authorization remains enforced.
- [ ] Failed live AI can continue via fixture mode.

## Depends on
#7–#17

## Demo evidence
Attach one uninterrupted recording.

title: Seed and reset deterministic demo scenario
body:
## Objective
Return every demo account and total to a known state safely.

## Owner role
Backend and Firebase + Gemma and Procurement

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One command resets emulator/shared demo data.
- [ ] Command refuses an unexpected Firebase project by default.
- [ ] Merchant/supplier accounts and all totals match the script.
- [ ] Reset is documented and rehearsed.

## Depends on
#12–#17

## Demo evidence
Show two identical runs after separate resets.

title: Write, rehearse, and back up final demo
body:
## Objective
Make delivery reliable even if network, AI, or presenter fails.

## Owner role
Lead and integration + all

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Demo succeeds five consecutive times within the time limit.
- [ ] Main and backup presenters have the script and recovery cues.
- [ ] Offline video and final-state screenshots are available.
- [ ] Stable version is tagged `demo-v1` after freeze.

## Depends on
#18, #19

## Demo evidence
Attach rehearsal log and backup asset locations.
